name: hv15_dbk_vp4_ctl

job.purpose: DMA STORE back DESC_LAT4 controller leaf, ONE master for all four stacks (stk[1:0] strap pin replaces STK/QID; DEDUPE); pins re-planned for the hb_dbk parent; logic otherwise = closed native-PASS rm1 (TT +71.41/FF +21.67). Bench: vp4 lockstep vs cursor + actual 4-stack 32VM/128SRAM production with stk=0..3 + mutants (stride, rows, landing addr, strap ignored) + reset/fault + wb_ready.

benches.name: lint
benches.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp4_controller u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/static/ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp4_banks.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/static/ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp_banks.sv && echo lint-ok

structural_change: DEDUPE (owner 19:50 fewer tiles, H-DIE grants v7): ONE controller master for all four stacks; the STK/QID parameters (descriptor stack check a_mv[134:133], acceptance c_hend_d[36:35], request sector queue bits) become a 2-bit strap pin stk[1:0] captured by a pin flop stk_q (die-level declared constant per instance). Pin faces re-planned for the hb_dbk parent (controller in the NE corner): die control + clock on E, writeback on N, rq/rr_valid/bank strobes W, bank_read_addr S. 0 cycles.

reroute_reason.why_route: stk strap pin replaces the STK/QID parameters (one master x4, DEDUPE); pin faces re-planned for the hb_dbk wires-only parent; closed rm1 view is STK=0-only.

pin_regs.reason: RTL registers every data input at the pin (a_mv/a_ci/a_cd/a_cb/a_ce, cycle_q, wa_q, wb_ready_q, rr_valid capture, stk_q) and drives every output from a flop; rst_n enters the local 2-flop reset_meta/reset_ready synchroniser; a wrapper stage would add +1/+1 to the compiled DESC_LAT4 schedule for nothing
